summary: Ardmore Shipping Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 15, 2026. The filing discloses the election of three Class I Directors (Mats Berglund, Kirsi Tikka, and Gernot Ruppelt) with vote counts, and lists continuing Class II and Class III directors. There are no special-situation terms, no acquisition or divestiture proposals, no premium or price per share, and no strategic changes. This is a routine foreign private issuer report of shareholder voting matters, equivalent to a Form 8-K Item 5.07 in the US. No further action or risk-arb angle applies.
